# ASTER DA MASTER — artist archive (llms-full.txt)

Private research archive for the underground artist **Aster da Master** (digicore/hyperpop orbit, scene tag "somelowlifes"). Static HTML + JSON API, all generated from `data/artist.json` by `scripts/build_*.py`. Data version: 0.14.0.

## The catalog (219 transmissions)

- **34 distributor releases** — 9 albums, 25 singles; verified via iTunes Search API primary metadata (Apple's own records), pulled 2026-10-11. Notable: *Master Key* (2019-12-23, label WoT), *Cast It:, Pt. 1* (2021), *Cast It:, Pt. 2* (2022), single "Reachhh" (2024-04-08, label "somelowlifes"), 2026 singles "The Night Ends Yeaaa" (Mar 25), "Writing Books" (May 2), "9 Trips" (May 3), "Living With The Big Shots" (May 5).
- **185 SoundCloud-only tracks** — read-only capture of soundcloud.com/asterdamaster (profile ID 259877060, 1,562 followers), 2026-10-11. Play counts are a snapshot and drift daily; every surface says so.
- Track-level research notes: earliest indexed track "Protections" (Dec 23, 2019, label "WoT", album *Master Key*, genre Hip-Hop/Rap); feature "ThtUDied (feat. Falinee & Aster Da Master)" on Jezzyman's *Internet Plug*.

## The circle (21 collaborators) + scene figures

21 title-credited collaborators, one page each in `circle/`: shared tracks (dates/plays, linked to release pages), shared-plays totals, years active, era breakdown. Credits parsed from w//ft./feat. fragments — as credited, verbatim; **producers excluded by rule**.

Wave 12 research enrichment (2026-10-11, public sources only, no lyrics, no invented biography):
- **capoxxo** (`circle/capoxxo.html`): named in Pitchfork's "A Deeply Incomplete Canon of Hyperpop-Digicore" (Kieran Press-Reynolds); collab tape *Persona* w/ mayh3mp (Cult Love Sound Tapes, 2022; 5 tracks, cassette run of 100); Aster Da Master tracks "candy" (2019-10-04, prod. razorwrist) and "getting colder" (2019-12-22, prod. pvscale x asa41).
- **pvscale** (`circle/pvscale.html`): produced "fly like me"; co-produced "getting colder" w/ asa41; also produces for capoxxo, lil koi, lil yu ("i miss you (feat. pvscale)"), kevinhilfiger/kidtrashpop ("buy It !").
- **Fish Narc** (`circle/fish-narc.html`, "Beyond the circle" scene figure — outside the 21-collaborator count): b. 1992, Seattle/Olympia; Thraxxhouse and GothBoiClique member; produced Lil Peep's *Goth Angel Sinner* LP; worked with Wicca Phase Springs Eternal, Lil Tracy, Horse Head, Cold Hart (live guitar instead of samples); solo LPs *WiLDFiRE* (2020), *Camouflage* (2022), *fruiting body* [KLP295] (2023), *frog song* (2025, K Records). Producer credit on "Pavement" (2019-12-30) and "Soul Shaking" (2018-01-03).
- **Wave 27 producer research (2026-10-11, evidence-flagged in `data/producer-research.json`, deep dives in `producers/`):** **ginseng** — multi-faceted producer, part of the D1 circle (Hella Sketchy, Shiro, Marcelo, Despair), runs the vocal project Lil Wintr (Underground Underdogs interviews 2019-01-28 and 2020-02-23); archive production "master key" ft. Lil Wintr x Marcelo. **Em Klebold** — type-beat producer with a Traktrain storefront and SoundClick catalog; uploads framed by uploaders around Lil Peep / XXXTentacion styles; archive production "Take Me". **pvscale** and **asa41** are archive-only (no independently verified external bio found; a single catalog-mirror source attributes further pvscale productions — lead only, unverified). **capoxxo, lil koi, lil yu** have no as-credited Aster productions — excluded from the producer deep dives by rule.

## Scene context + unknowns (method.html)

- "somelowlifes" is the artist's own bio tag and the Shazam-listed label on "Reachhh" (2024) — the imprint's most solid public anchor.
- Best SomeLowLifes network evidence: May 15, 2020 Internet Phantoms Network podcast episode billed as "joined by 2 members of SomeLowLifes" (members unnamed in metadata); playlist links Lil' Spursy, DirtyDoves/DoveShxt, Offline HP, Aster Da Master, producer Lil' Flower ("InternetWouldBlush"). **Evidence, not a roster.**
- Digicore background: heavy autotune, layered melodies, nightcore influence, pandemic-era Discord/bedroom culture; Bladee as central reference; Jane Remover "the face of digicore" (The Fader); 2024–25 evolution toward rage music.
- **The unknowns register (flagged, not filled):** SomeLowLifes member roster; "litemode / nitemode" meaning (words appear in titles — see codex "The Modes" — no source defines them); public profiles for Max Ferrari, Yung Vetta, Lil Yu, JAX, YungSkah, AWFL, shinju, odece, lil biscuit, wetgropes, Born Hero; razorwrist and Lil' Flower verified only at title-credit level; no press/interviews/features found.
- Do-not-confuse: "The Lowlifes" (unrelated Last.fm disambiguation collective), LOWLIFE (Essex trio, Hellcat Records), Low Life (Australian punk, Goner Records).

## Pages

Home `index.html` (discography) · `releases/` (219 pages + index) · `years/` (2018–2026 + index) · `circle/` (21 + 1 scene figure) · `codex/` (16 vocabulary families, each with a deep-dive page: decoded reading, era evolution, key sessions, collaborators, producers) · `producers/` (113 as-credited producers, each with a deep-dive page: credited productions, codex family ties, computed fingerprint, sourced research where a pass exists; data `api/v1/producer-deepdives.json` via `scripts/build_producer_deepdives.py`, last in the chain) · `timeline.html` · `network.html` (collaboration universe: interactive SVG graph of the 21 title-credited collaborators + producer scene figures, track-weighted edges, co-credit links, era slider, producers toggle, name search, accessible table, computed insights; data `api/v1/network.json` via `scripts/build_network.py`) · `decoder.html` (transmission decoder) · `api-playground.html` (Explore + Skill recipes tabs) · `AGENT.md` (agent operator's manual: base URL, key endpoints, 7 end-to-end workflows) · `agents.html` (agentic surface: 22-endpoint API table, llms, skills, search-index usage, 5 worked writeups) · `method.html` (methodology, scene context, unknowns) · `trilogy.html` (Litemode Trilogy watch) · `sessions.html` + `sessions/` (61 upload sessions, 10 deep-dives) + `sessions-explorer.html` (explorable timeline: 9 activity seasons, 60 inter-session gaps, per-session deepest cuts, era/year filters; data `api/v1/session-clusters.json`) + session explorer 2.0 tooling (head-to-head compare, deepest-sessions editorial ranking, keyboard timeline scrubber; data `api/v1/session-tools.json`) + `milestone-race.html` (the milestone race: approaching play-count milestones ranked by gap-closing proximity, the 30,088-play summit chase, session + era records; data `api/v1/milestone-races.json` — pace arithmetic, never predictions) · `changelog.html` · `glance.html` · `press-kit.html` · `transmission.html` (flagship guided journey: six eras 2018→2026 plus three live data chapters — The Race + The Record Book (data: `api/v1/milestone-races.json`), The Codex (data: `api/v1/codex-families.json`), no figures hardcoded; per-era stats, defining tracks, key sessions, collaborators, milestones, computed signal lines, the 2026 era's verified-2026-singles + Q4-2026-watch extras; keyboard + auto-play + journey map with visited stops + resume-from-last-stop + share-a-stop deep links (`transmission.html#era-<id>` / `#chapter-<id>`) + share text; each era node and journey-map card links to its deep-dive page) · `eras/` (six era deep-dive pages: full transmission lists with plays, every in-era collaborator, active codex families, computed signal summaries; data `api/v1/eras.json` via `scripts/build_eras.py`).

Design: "UNDERGROUND TRANSMISSION" — semantic HTML, ARIA landmarks, keyboard-accessible, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected, mobile-first.

## Skills (skills/, registry skills/index.json)

Twelve playbooks in Use when / Inputs / Procedure / Worked example / API references / Pitfalls format. Archive-analysis skills and their endpoint sequences:

- `deep-cuts-finder` — surfaces the vault's quietest-play tracks for playlists. `sessions.json` → flatten → sort asc by plays → `codex.json` for playlist themes. Deepest: "nitemode2019 w/ Max+Vetty prod. NaXi.wav" (17 plays), median ≈ 450.
- `session-archaeology` — reconstructs one of the 61 sessions. `sessions.json` → `circle.json`/`scene-figures.json` → `codex.json` → `artist.json` eras. Sessions are upload-date clusters (7-day gap rule), not recording dates.
- `collaborator-tracer` — maps a collaborator's footprint. `circle.json` → `scene-figures.json` (producer fallback; circle is title-credit only) → `artist.json` eras. Example: capoxxo — 2 tracks, 16,174 plays, 2019; *Persona* tape w/ mayh3mp (2022).
- `milestone-watcher` — near round-number play counts. `milestone-watch.json` → sort bands by `needed`. Summit: "Take Me (prod. Em Klebold)" 30,088 plays; near-1k: "[outro] Off Beat ft. Yung Vetta (prod. Addy)" 65 needed.
- `era-briefing` — summarizes one of six eras for a writeup. `eras.json` (deep-dives: full tracks, all collaborators, active families, computed summary) → `artist.json` eras → `years.json` → `discography` → `circle.json`. Example: "The SomeLowLifes Era", rank #2 of 6 by plays (14,982, 5.82%), busiest year 2023 (31 transmissions).
- `transmission-decoder` — interprets a title word via the 16 codex families. `codex.json` → `sessions.json`; mirrors `decoder.html`. Example: `nitemode` → family "The Modes" (5 transmissions, 2019 + 2024 clusters).
- `codex-reader` — reads a codex family's full deep-dive. `codex-families.json` → `decoded` (stated or honestly unknown) → `eras[]` (evolution, deep-dive + journey links) → `transmissions[]` → `key_sessions[]` → `collaborators[]`; mirrors `codex/<slug>.html`. Example: The Rites — 17 transmissions, 11,052 plays, 5 eras active, first "Fuck Time 3 (outro)" 2018-11-08.
- `milestone-race-reader` — reads the milestone race: approaching milestones ranked, the 30,088-play summit chase, records, what's just crossed. `milestone-races.json` → `closest_races[]` → `play_races[]` → `summit_race` → records; pace figures are arithmetic, never predictions. Example: closest race is "master key ft. Lil Wintr x Marcelo (prod. ginseng)" — 9,615 of 10,000 plays, ~100.3 days at lifetime pace (estimate, not a prediction).
- `network-graph-reader` — reads the collaboration network: nodes, track-weighted edges, co-credit links, insights. `network.json` → `insights` → `circle.json`. Example: Max Ferrari ×8 (most frequent); co-credit edges jax↔max-ferrari (2), max-ferrari↔yung-vetta (1).
- `session-compare` — compares any two sessions head to head (tracks, plays, avg, span, era, loudest/deepest cut, collaborator overlap); reads the deepest-sessions editorial ranking (formula stated). `session-tools.json` → `sessions[]` → `deepest_cuts`. Example: session-02 (loudest, 30,088) vs session-43 (deepest, 83.5 avg): +1 transmission, −29,921 plays, −30,004.5 avg; both solo runs.
- `codex-pathfinder` — traces the shortest connection between any two codex figures (BFS over `edges[]`); reads BFS degrees of separation from Aster and family-overlap pairs. `codex-network.json` → `edges[]` → `degrees[]` → `family_overlap[]`. Example: JAX → The Modes → runawway (2 steps); capoxxo ↔ Lil Wintr has no codex-only path (both families isolated) — the honest no-path state.
- `announce-release`, `build-press-kit`, `verify-platform-links` — publishing helpers.

Agent rules: static JSON, no auth, no rate limits (serve over HTTP — `file://` blocks fetch); play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot (always state it); upload dates ≠ recording dates; titles/metadata only — never lyrics, never invent bio facts; producers are outside the circle by rule.

## API (api/v1/)

| endpoint | file |
|---|---|
| artist | api/v1/artist.json |
| changelog | api/v1/changelog.json |
| circle | api/v1/circle.json |
| codex | api/v1/codex.json |
| codex-families | api/v1/codex-families.json |
| first-last | api/v1/first-last.json |
| index (self-describing manifest: description, schema URL, updated, records, notes per endpoint) | api/v1/index.json |
| milestone-watch | api/v1/milestone-watch.json |
| milestones | api/v1/milestones.json |
| network | api/v1/network.json |
| on-this-day | api/v1/on-this-day.json |
| release-slugs | api/v1/release-slugs.json |
| scene-figures | api/v1/scene-figures.json |
| sessions | api/v1/sessions.json |
| transmission | api/v1/transmission.json |
| years | api/v1/years.json |

`data/artist.json` sections: version, observed, research_status, artist, collaborators, featured_release, discography, platforms, socials, booking, eras, vault, upcoming. Enriched circle entries carry `verified_notes` (research_pass, facts, sources). Scene figures carry `kind`, `standing`, tracks, facts, sources.

## Generators

`scripts/build_*.py` — dependency order: releases → years → circle → codex → sessions → session_deepdives → milestones → milestone_watch → firstlast → glance → search_index → changelog → transmission → network → eras → session_clusters → codex_pages → milestone_races → session_tools → codex_network → producer_deepdives. Each reads `data/artist.json`; version-writing scripts set `version` (0.14.0) and mirror to `api/v1/artist.json` / `api/v1/index.json`. All manifest writes go through `scripts/api_manifest.py` (canonical endpoints/meta/skills/documents rebuild — the chain is byte-stable regardless of generator order). `scripts/verify_agent_workflows.js` executes the 7 AGENT.md example workflows against the real local api/v1 JSON. Never hand-edit generated pages; edit the script or data and re-run.

## Ops

Repo: private GitHub-only (`astercast/aster-da-master`), **no Vercel**. Live ops documented in `GO_LIVE.md`: weekly SoundCloud play-count refresh (`scripts/refresh/refresh.sh`, 4-tier pipeline — client_id extraction from public web-app JS, snapshot overlay, human-reviewed merge). Push via `python3 ~/workspace/skills/github/bin/gh-push.py ~/workspace/aster-da-master`; the connector credential lacks the `workflow` scope — `.github/workflows/*` files must be added via the GitHub web UI.
